title: Kissed Crisp Northern-Irish Bread Toasted Sandwich
description: A briny, crisp, date-night bread toasted sandwich, inspired by British Northern-Irish cuisine, with a focus on shojin-friendly ingredients and flavors.

ingredients.name: Double Rise Northern Irish Bread
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, crusty on the outside, airy on the inside.

ingredients.name: Cucumber
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced for crunch and refreshment.

ingredients.name: Cheddar Cheese
ingredients.notes: Smooth and creamy, a perfect complement to the brininess of the bacon.

ingredients.name: Fresh Chives
ingredients.notes: Finely chopped for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: To taste, for a touch of warmth.

ingredients.name: Champagne Vinegar
ingredients.notes: A drizzle of tanginess to balance the richness.

instructions: Preheat the grill to a medium heat, around 275°F.
Toast the bread slices until they are golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile, cook the Irish smoked bacon in a pan until crispy.
Layer the cucumber slices on top of the toasted bread, followed by a slice of cheese, a few pieces of crispy bacon, and a sprinkle of chives.
